findings.title: Choosing "Full (current)" on an undraftable pawn's menu now quietly switches it to Stationary
findings.detail: The comment at line 239-240 says a Full mode set earlier stays and shows as current even when Full is no longer offered. With the new downgrade in the click handler, if the clicked pawn has drafter == null and an old Full mode, picking that 'current' entry stores Stationary, not Full. Behaviour is the same, since Full acts as Stationary for that pawn. But the menu said 'current', so the player would expect no change, and the badge will change from the Full text to the Stationary text. Either skip the clicked pawn when m == current, or accept it and update the comment.
